comparison.objective: Identify, orient and load tapes into ordered magazine slots; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Barcode reading, reorientation by handoff and cartridge insertion versus recessed socket manipulation, fine collar adjustment and iterative testing.
comparison.success_condition: Four cartridges ordered, upright, flush, label-out and robot clear versus two safe stops with force, travel, rebound and drift constraints.
comparison.reason: Ordered identification and magazine loading test a different ability from mechanical tuning and response validation.
